structured_output.summary: The reference value of 0 is correct, but the engine narrative gives the wrong reason for it. Child 1 is 10 years old with household income of about $60,010 (MAGI) to $61,277, which is roughly 182–186% of the 2026 poverty guideline of $33,000 for a family of four. That clears PA's Medicaid limit of 133% for children aged 6–18 and falls within PA's CHIP income range (free up to 208%, low-cost up to 314%). Even so, the child is ineligible: federal Title XXI and 42 CFR 457.310 do not count a child covered by a group health plan as a targeted low-income child, PA DHS requires CHIP children to be 'Uninsured and not eligible for Medical Assistance', and the prompt says Child 1 has employer-sponsored insurance all year. The narrative says income is above PA's CHIP limit, which is wrong, since about 186% FPL is well under 314%. This may just be the narrative misdescribing the trace. It does not change the output on these facts, but the developer may want to confirm that the engine's PA CHIP income limit is set correctly.
